# #456 Rapportsnurran

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-11-05  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Market Makers #456, recorded the day after the US midterms (4 Nov 2026), opens with macro and AI talk. The hosts argue that AI subsidies are fading, token costs are rising, AI-heavy tech names are being punished, Fed hike odds are falling, and AI raises the need for IT security. The main segment is a run through Q3 reports. Chefello fell sharply but the host still holds it, Reddit crashed despite strong numbers and the host sold, Hacksaw's report after its profit warning was weak and the host stays out, and Adtraction showed a turnaround with its first profitable Q3 since 2023.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 CHEF — Chefello | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host stays an owner after the ~10% drop: new-customer acquisition accelerated in the quarter, Q4 is trending close to last year, EV/EBIT ~8.

#### Reasoning

Q3 EBIT was positive for the first time in a Q3 and beat the host's estimate by SEK 1m. Active customers are weak, but intra-quarter acquisition is improving and Q4 is near last year's level. Management is confident about 2027 growth and margin scaling. Valuation is EV/EBIT 8 with a cash build and ~10% potential yield. Risks: HelloFresh marketing push, Q4 one-offs (SEK 3-4m fees, logistics costs) and higher marketing hitting margins.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new-customer acquisition trend reverses in Q4 trading update
- if active customers keep falling QoQ
- if HelloFresh marketing push erodes share
- if 2027 margin/growth guidance fails

> *"I och med att man snarare säger att det går åt andra hållet så ligger jag kvar som ägare i aktien."*

---

### 🔴 RDDT — Reddit | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host sold at the open after the 30% drop: the market ignores ARPU/FCF and focuses on user decline. He still watches it and sees a possible second round.

#### Reasoning

The thesis on monetisation (ARPU +53%, FCF nearly doubled, near-zero capex) was confirmed. But the market prices user growth, and DAU may fall by a low double-digit percentage in Q4 because of Google AI mode and the login requirement. The host thinks the valuation (~12x 2027 FCF, $3bn net cash) looks cheap but that the multiple may be reset by AI uncertainty. He admits he may have sold the bottom.

#### Sell Triggers

- re-entry if logged-in US users keep growing
- re-entry if DAU decline smaller than warned in Q4
- if FCF holds despite traffic loss

> *"Så jag sålde faktiskt min position i öppningen."*

---

### 🟠 HACK — Hacksaw | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Host is less keen to buy back in after a weak report: Q3 fell QoQ, answers were vague, Q4 is weak, and the buyback and insider buy were token-sized.

#### Reasoning

Short-term problems may persist and the 30% growth target looks like hope. Management gave illogical answers on why sales fell. The buyback was only 1% of market cap despite a large cash pile, and the CFO buy was SEK 200k. The host will wait for a confirmed fundamental turnaround. Prediction markets are an option but face intense competition.

#### Sell Triggers

- buy trigger: clear fundamental turnaround with explained causes
- if Q4 confirms continued revenue decline

> *"Men jag blir ju mer osugen på att köpa in mig igen efter rapporten. Tänker att jag vill vänta till man ser en fundamental vändning"*

---

### 🟠 ADTR — Adtraction | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Strong Q3, first profitable Q3 since 2023, margins improving each quarter, EBITA up ~90%. Host finds it interesting but has not bought.

#### Reasoning

Affiliate business turning around after falling revenue in 2024-25: gross profit has risen four quarters in a row, cash flow is good and estimates are bullish. The risk is the finance segment's exposure to consumer credit, which faces Swedish regulation. The 'other' segment was also weak in prior years.

#### Sell Triggers

- if finance segment hit by further consumer-credit regulation
- if margin improvement stalls
- if revenue growth turns negative again

> *"Jättefin rapport. Aktien upp 7 procent ungefär. Det här är första lönsamma Q3an sedan 2023."*
